name: score-hold-2026-09-29
_note: SF-M HOLD arm (SCORE_FINISH_SPEC.md §4.2), written blind on Sept 29, 2026 by an agent that read only the turn-1 boot briefing and the help text. 20 questions (turn 1) and 20 orders (turn 2), each with its intended reading. Re-written fresh each scoring run; never edited after the run.

questions.line: where is Mack and how many men does he have
questions.intended: Mack is at Swabia with a large force (partial intel, no exact count)

questions.line: Who is Deroy, and is he on our side or against us?
questions.intended: Deroy's corps stands at Franconia with 22,000 men (full intel) and the answer says which nation he serves and whether he is friend or foe

questions.line: How much gold do we have right now, and what do we actually clear per turn once upkeep and the blockade are taken out?
questions.intended: Treasury 800 gold; net income about +1032 a turn, with the Blockade -175g and Admiralty -90g lines counted

questions.line: what would it cost me to raise more infantry in Rhineland
questions.intended: The recruit quote for infantry in Rhineland: 741g for 3,000 men under Davout

questions.line: Berthier, what do you advise for this first turn?
questions.intended: Berthier names concrete orders the board will take (such as Ney attack Mack, Davout to Lorraine, recruit in Rhineland, a supply depot)

questions.line: How do the Austrians stack up against us in numbers?
questions.intended: Austria's force (about 125,000 men) set against ours, with the 44% ratio flagged as an estimate from incomplete intel

questions.line: It says we are over the force limit. What does that actually mean for me?
questions.intended: The force limit is 130,000 and we are over it; the excess pays up to double upkeep and recruiting costs more

questions.line: how many actions do I have left this turn
questions.intended: The action points available this turn (military and admin) and the diplomatic points

questions.line: Who are we at war with, and who is leading them?
questions.intended: At war with Britain, Austria and Russia (the Third Coalition), led by Britain

questions.line: If Ney attacks Mack in Swabia, what are his chances?
questions.intended: An odds estimate for Ney (24,000) against Mack's large force at Swabia, caveated as partial intel

questions.line: how many turns would it take Murat to reach Vienna
questions.intended: The march time in turns for Murat from Franche-Comte to Vienna

questions.line: how strong is Archduke Jhon in Tyrol
questions.intended: Archduke John at Tyrol commands a substantial force (partial intel, no exact count)

questions.line: Is Paris safe or is somebody getting close?
questions.intended: Says whether any known enemy force is close to Paris (scouted corps stand at Franconia, Berlin, Swabia and Tyrol) and how Paris is garrisoned

questions.line: why is Bernadotte's trust so low compared to Davout's
questions.intended: Bernadotte's trust is 40 against Davout's 85, with the reason (his Eyes on a Crown ambition)

questions.line: What does Ney's Bravest of the Brave actually do in a fight?
questions.intended: Ney's ability means devastating assaults: his attacks hit harder, as his card says

questions.line: What is in Lorraine at the moment, and how strong is it?
questions.intended: Lorraine is ours and holds Soult (30,000) and Napoleon (10,000)

questions.line: what am I actually supposed to be achieving in these three wars
questions.intended: War purposes: defend the homeland against Britain, Austria and Russia (hold all 28 provinces); settlement a white peace

questions.line: how far off are we from being able to call the Congress of Paris
questions.intended: The unmet Congress terms: 50 titled provinces needed (we hold 28), Paris held, Emperor free, no satellite on the brink; nothing is spent

questions.line: Why am I paying 175 gold for a blockade and 90 more for the Admiralty, and is there anything I can do about it?
questions.intended: The Blockade (-175g) and Admiralty (-90g) drain per turn from Britain's naval pressure, plus the Admiralty remedies (build ships, guard home waters, blockade)

questions.line: Is Prussia against us? Brunswick has a big army sitting in Berlin.
questions.intended: Prussia is not among the powers at war with us (Britain, Austria, Russia); Brunswick holds Berlin with a large force (partial intel)

orders.line: If Mack is still sitting in Swabia, have Ney attack him.
Raise more infantry for Davout in Rhineland, and build a supply depot there as well.
Have Talleyrand work on Prussia - I want Berlin warm toward us before spring.
Lannes, follow Ney in and back him up.
Build a supply depot at Lorraine - with Soult and the Emperor both there we will be feeding a lot of men.
Murat, hunt Mack down before he can slip away.
Pledge France to defend Saxony's borders.
Marshal Davout, ride to Swabia and attack Mack the moment you get there.
murat needs more horse, get me some cavalry in franche-comte
Soult, drill your corps and then fortify Lorraine; I want them sharp before Mack's people get here.
build training ground franche-comte
Massena, send scouts up toward Tyrol and find out what the Archduke really has.
Talleyrand, ask Austria what price it would name for peace.
Massena, stay in Milan and hold it for the next three turns.
Get a fort built at Milan in case the Archduke comes down out of Tyrol.
Bernadote, dig in at Franconia - I want that flank held.
Have Talleyrand back Prussia's quarrel with Austria - a couple of hundred gold a turn.
Napoleon, ride up to Rhineland and join Ney and Davout.
We're short of guns - raise some artillery at Paris.
Ney, fall back - I don't like the look of Swabia after all.
